meta_description:
61K likes, 354 comments - malvikasitlaniofficial on March 22, 2026: "Your life will never be perfect. 
It will rise & fall. It will test you again and again an again. 

But your power lies in showing up. 

Even when you’re healing. 
Even when you’re hurting. 

Consistency is a choice. Discipline is a decision. 
And both will carry you through what motivation never can. 

You don’t need a new life. 
You need a new standard for yourself 💪🏼❤️

I lost something back then but I lost double the amount recently…how you choose to design your life is in your hands 💛🙏🏼
Whatever happens, do not give up.".
